_about: Side-by-side comparison of the rule and today's Federal Reserve. Published figures are audited numbers with their sources; other figures are computed each run from the stored public data. This compares what the Fed did with what the rule's formula would have said, not outcomes: had the rule been in charge, the economy would have behaved differently.

published.source: Federal Reserve Banks, Combined Financial Statements as of and for the Years Ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 (audited by KPMG), pp. 3-5
